title: Pointwise invertible simplicial natural transformations give equal homotopy classes
statement: Use small simplicial categories, their path-component categories $\pi_0$, Dwyer--Kan equivalences and the model homotopy category $h\mathrm{sCat}$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-inversion-universal-property], in fixed containing universes. Let $A,B$ be small simplicial categories and $F,G:A\to B$ simplicial functors. Suppose there is a family of vertex arrows $\eta_a:Fa\to Ga$ such that for every pair $a,a^{\prime}$ the two simplicial maps $A(a,a^{\prime})\to B(Fa,Ga^{\prime})$ given by $u\mapsto\eta_{a^{\prime}}F(u)$ and $u\mapsto G(u)\eta_a$ are equal. Suppose each $[\eta_a]$ is an isomorphism in $\pi_0B$. Then $[F]=[G]$ in $\operatorname{Hom}_{h\mathrm{sCat}}(A,B)$. Neither $A$ nor $B$ is required cofibrant or locally Kan; the empty source is allowed.

source.place: Agent-formulated generalization of the natural-transformation step of Lemma A.3.5.6, printed p.894. It follows from Proposition A.3.5.5 and Lemma A.3.5.14, printed pp.893 and 896, by localizing the vertical arrows in [1] times A. It is not claimed to be the literal statement of A.3.4.10.
